ESP-GSP browser player (gsp_sim.js / gsp_sim.wasm / gsp_sim.d.ts)

Copied from official Component Registry espressif/esp-gsp 1.0.0
prebuilt/sim/wasm. Used by `run.py --scene-player`. The default
interactive preview compiles `tools/gsp-sim/host` against the same
1.0.0 package (`fetch_gspc.py --sdk`).
